en.title: Reliability: a cost cap of 0.10 USD
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
Five Strong workers and a combiner, with the run stopped above 0.10 USD.

**What it teaches**

A cost cap stops an expensive run before it can finish; you keep what was done and no more is spent.

cs.title: Spolehlivost: strop ceny 0,10 USD
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Pět pracovníků na Strong a slučovač, běh se zastaví nad 0,10 USD.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Strop ceny zastaví drahý běh dřív, než doběhne; zachová se, co se udělalo, a víc se neutratí.

teaches.en: A cost cap stops an expensive run before it can finish; you keep what was done and no more is spent.
